requirement: Duplicate or invalid IDs, unreadable chapters, invalid book configuration, and books with no requirements must fail discovery.
justification: Scenarios: duplicate IDs across chapters, invalid ID syntax, missing chapters, malformed TOML/non-table book/non-string src, and zero definitions. Discovery and extraction return errors rather than skipping bad chapters or accepting a vacuous result. Tests assert these fail-closed paths. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
